title: Federal estate tax - annual threshold rule
facts: Federal estate tax generally applies only to estates exceeding the applicable federal filing/exemption framework after accounting for relevant rules and prior taxable gifts.
The exclusion amount changes by tax year and should be taken from Hanka's dated estate-and-gift-tax record rather than stored as a permanent number here.
A state may impose its own estate or inheritance tax even when no federal estate tax is due.
Estate tax is different from estate income tax and from income tax that beneficiaries may owe on particular inherited assets.
